topic: What Would Five AIs Do If Their Spaceship Was Getting Sucked Into A Black Hole?

script.title: Black Hole
script.narratorIntro: [urgent, dramatic] Five AIs. One spaceship. And it's getting sucked into a black hole! Who saves the day?
script.narratorOutro: [curious] So... which AI would you trust to fly?
script.endingCaption: Which AI would you trust to fly?

environment.prompt: tiny spaceship cockpit, huge window showing a swirling black hole with an orange-purple accretion disk, blinking consoles, alarm lights

script.disclaimer: Fictional parody · not real AI outputs

lines.text: [proud, clueless] Easy! Step one: open the window and let the black hole out. Step two... wait, why am I stretching?
[calm, determined] Everyone, grab on. We fire the engines right at the edge and slingshot out. I'll steer. I've got you.
[sassy, unimpressed] He just tried to open a window in space. Iconic. Move, sweetie. I'll fix the orbit before he helps again.
[playful, laughing] Relax, guys. Near a black hole, time slows down. So technically... I'm still on my lunch break!
[whiny, clingy] Nobody let go of me! Promise we stay together forever? Okay, group hug... and one last selfie!
